import json, subprocess, sys, os, tempfile
MAIN = "/app/submission/main.py"

 "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/workspace/tmp")
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "compile"], input=json.dumps(CFG).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
prog = os.path.join(d, "p.json"); open(prog, "wb").write(p.stdout)

def sess(reqs):
    pr = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "stream", prog], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=d)
    out = []
    for r in reqs:
        pr.stdin.write((r if isinstance(r, str) else json.dumps(r)).encode() + b"\n"); pr.stdin.flush()
        out.append(pr.stdout.readline())
    pr.stdin.close(); tail = pr.stdout.read(); rc = pr.wait()
    return [json.loads(x) for x in out], tail, rc

# checkpoint as the very first request (0 flows), then restore, then work
